name: Lionel
source:
The youngest Far East Branch manager in history. While he is an excellent savant, there are many mysterious deaths surrounding him, hence why he is called the "savant killer" in the shadows.

In order to solve the disappearance incident that occurred at the Far East Branch, Yuni decided to transfer.. he speaks and acts familiarly to Uni, but he has no memory of him at all.

[Translated from [url=http://b-cluster.eek.jp/raid/character_detail.html#lionel]official website[/url]]
